questions.question: In Jeremiah's letter, what did the LORD tell the exiles in Babylon to seek for the city where He had sent them?
Some prophets among the exiles in Babylon spoke in the LORD's name. What did the LORD say about them?

answers.text: He sent them to test His people
They will be proven right later

questions.question: In Jeremiah's letter, after Babylon's seventy years were complete, the LORD promised to restore the exiles to which city?
In Jeremiah's letter to the exiles in Babylon, what did the LORD say His plans for them were meant to do?

answers.text: Prosper them and not harm them
